name: SSP Karnataka Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Comprehensive state fee concession, tuition waiver, and maintenance allowance for students having Karnataka domicile.
applicationSteps: Create an account on the Karnataka SSP Post-Matric portal with your Aadhaar.
Get your study, fee, and previous marksheets e-Attested by your college e-Attestation officer.
Enter your Caste/Income Certificate RD numbers from Nadakacheri.
Submit the application and download the acknowledgement receipt to submit to your college scholarship desk.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per annum towards college fee, books, and laptops for meritorious female students admitted into technical degree/diploma programs.
documents: Annual Family Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (< 8 LPA)
Admission Letter from AICTE approved institute
Tuition Fee Receipt paid to the college
Bank passbook copy with IFSC and Aadhaar seeding declaration
applicationSteps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with One-Time Registration (OTR).
Select 'AICTE Pragati Scheme for Girls (Degree/Diploma)'.
Upload verified parent income certificate and fee receipts.
Application is verified at Institute Level (INM) followed by State Nodal Officer.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Prestigious merit-cum-means scholarship with leadership development for first-year degree students across India (income preference < 2.5 LPA).
documents: Family Income Proof (ITR / Salary slip / Tehsildar certificate)
Proof of admission in full-time undergraduate program
applicationSteps: Complete initial eligibility questionnaire on Reliance Foundation portal.
Submit personal details, academic scores, and write a statement of purpose.
Appear for the online aptitude test (60 minutes, logical & numerical reasoning).
Shortlisted candidates receive scholarship disbursement in phased tranches.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSSS)
provider: Department of Higher Education (Govt of India)
description: Awarded to meritorious students who scored above 80th percentile in Class 12 board examinations pursuing regular degree courses.
documents: Income Certificate from competent revenue authority (< 4.5 LPA)
applicationSteps: Generate NSP One-Time Registration (OTR).
Apply under 'Department of Higher Education - CSSS'.
Submit college roll number and upload board certificate.
Verification completed by College Nodal Officer via NSP portal.

name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship for Girls
description: Substantial financial grant of ₹1.5 Lakh per year for meritorious girl students pursuing professional graduation in NAAC/NIRF accredited colleges.
documents: Proof of admission in accredited college (Rank card / Fee receipt)
applicationSteps: Apply through Buddy4Study / Kotak Education portal.
Upload admission letters, fee receipts, and marks cards.
Participate in telephonic interview round.
Final selection based on financial need and academic excellence.

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's ECSS Programme
description: Educational crisis assistance for students from economically weaker sections facing financial hardship to prevent dropping out.
documents: Proof of family income (< 2.5 LPA) or document proving family crisis
Bank passbook details with IFSC code
applicationSteps: Register on Buddy4Study portal.
Complete 'HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS' form.
Upload proof of economic hardship and tuition bill.
Direct benefit transfer (DBT) disbursed into bank account.

name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
description: Renowned private charitable scholarship supporting deserving students from underprivileged backgrounds across India.
documents: Income certificate (< 4 LPA for employed, < 2.5 LPA for others)
Certificate regarding fees from College Principal
Hostel stay certificate (if applicable for enhanced stipend)
applicationSteps: Download official application form from SJF website.
Fill and get attested by the Principal/Head of the Institute.
Send hard copy along with required attachments to Jindal Foundation Bangalore office.
Stipend is dispatched via cheque/NEFT quarterly.

name: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Scheme (YASASVI)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (Govt of India)
description: Prestigious central scholarship for OBC, EBC, and Nomadic Tribe students studying in top identified schools and colleges across India.
documents: Aadhaar Number linked with bank account
applicationSteps: Register on NSP portal with OTR credential.
Apply under MSJE PM-YASASVI Top Class Education scheme.
Institute verification completed online by College Nodal Officer.
Scholarship credited via PFMS directly to Aadhaar seeded bank.

name: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial assistance to Economically Backward Class (EBC) students studying at post-matriculation level.
documents: EBC Income Certificate from authorized revenue authority
College Admission and Fee Structure receipt
applicationSteps: Log into National Scholarship Portal.
Select 'Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC'.
Upload income certificate and mark sheets.
Submit for college and district welfare officer approval.

name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme
provider: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) Golden Jubilee Foundation
description: Supports economically weaker students pursuing higher studies in medicine, engineering, graduation in any discipline, or diploma/vocational courses.
documents: Class 10th / 12th marks sheet with at least 60% marks
Proof of admission in recognized college
applicationSteps: Apply online on LIC official portal under Golden Jubilee Foundation.
Select nearest LIC Divisional Office.
Submit academic score and family income breakdown.
Shortlisted candidates called for verification at divisional office.

name: Tata Trusts Medical and Healthcare Scholarship
description: Merit and need-based tuition fee waiver for undergraduate students enrolled in healthcare, medicine, and nursing across recognized institutions.
documents: NEET Rank Letter & College Admission Letter
Income proof / Salary slip of earning family members
Fee structure signed by college authorities
applicationSteps: Access Tata Trusts Individual Grants portal.
Register student profile and choose Medical & Healthcare Grant.
Upload college tuition fee receipts and marks sheet.
Trusts team evaluates and disburses grant directly to institution.

name: L'Oréal India For Young Women In Science Scholarship
description: Empowers promising young women from families with annual income under 6 Lakhs who achieved 85%+ in Class 12 (PCB/PCM) to pursue STEM degrees.
documents: Class 10th and 12th Mark sheets (min 85% in PCB/PCM)
Proof of admission in recognized college for science/engineering/medicine
Family Income Certificate / Salary Slips / ITR
applicationSteps: Apply through Buddy4Study / L'Oreal portal.
Submit academic essay and college entrance score.
Shortlisted candidates participate in video/telephonic interview with scientific jury.
Awardees receive financial grant disbursed annually.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
description: Financial grant of ₹50,000 per annum for specially-abled students with >= 40% disability enrolled in AICTE approved technical degree/diploma courses.
documents: Tuition Fee receipt and college admission allotment letter
applicationSteps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
Select 'AICTE Saksham Scheme for Specially-Abled'.
Upload disability certificate and bank details.
Institutional verification completed by College Nodal Officer.

name: ONGC Foundation Merit Scholarship
provider: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC Foundation)
description: Merit-based financial aid for economically disadvantaged SC, ST, OBC, and EWS students enrolled in 1st year Engineering or MBBS programs.
documents: College Admission Letter and College ID card
Bank ECS mandate form with cancelled cheque
applicationSteps: Visit the ONGC Scholar portal.
Register and fill out the online application form.
Upload certified copies of certificates and college fee receipt.
Shortlisted candidates receive direct benefit transfer into their bank account.

name: Santos Foundation Higher Education Grant
description: Provides financial support to underprivileged students pursuing undergraduate degree and diploma courses across government colleges.
applicationSteps: Submit application on portal with academic details.
Upload documents and income proofs.
Undergo telephone interview if shortlisted.

name: ACC Vidyasaarathi Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship opportunity for students pursuing higher professional education residing near industrial operational locations or accredited colleges.
documents: College Admission Letter and fee structure
applicationSteps: Sign in to Protean Vidyasaarathi portal.
Search for ACC scholarship scheme matching your stream.
Upload documents and submit.
Direct disbursement into verified student bank account.

name: Sant Nirankari Higher Education Assistance
description: Financial assistance on merit-cum-means basis to deserving students admitted into recognized technical and professional institutions in India.
documents: Marksheet of 12th or preceding semester examination
Fee payment receipt of current academic semester
applicationSteps: Download Education Assistance form from Nirankari Mandal portal.
Attach verified copies of marksheets and parent income certificate.
Submit before deadline to the Education Department at Delhi head office.

name: Aditya Birla Capital Foundation Crisis Grant
description: Special crisis scholarship ensuring continuity of education for students who have suffered a family breadwinner loss or severe economic setback.
documents: Mark sheet of previous academic year
Proof of crisis (Breadwinner demise certificate / Medical crisis proof)
Current year admission and fee receipt
applicationSteps: Complete application on Buddy4Study under Aditya Birla Capital Foundation.
Upload proof of crisis and college bonafide.
Telephonic and document verification.
Direct college fee disbursement or account transfer.
